name: Partner showcase
hook: So you can link products like these.
beats: What the partner carries (cutouts fly in)
"So you can link products like these"
notes: Done: Backcountry, Scuba.com and West Marine.
Next: Osprey, Gregory, Kailas, Suunto, Adorama, SunnySports.
settings: Osprey or Gregory: a fully loaded pack with a desk lamp clipped to it.
Adorama: Luke as his own news crew, filming himself filming.
SunnySports: a beach umbrella at the crag.
Kailas: a big wall, or a hangboard in the office.

name: Kit check, newsroom edition
window: Anytime, works as a recurring segment
hook: Breaking news: here's what's in my pack.
beats: Luke unpacks on a desk outdoors
Each item as a cutout plus one line on why
"Every pick is on my GearBook page."
notes: Rotate: a crag day, a ski tour, a dive day, a sailing day.
Member upgrade: "We sent our correspondent to [member]'s pack."

name: Reporting live from the job
window: Anytime, pick the trip you're on that week
hook: Reporting live from [single-pitch / ski tour / dive boat]. Here's what goes in the bag.
notes: This is where the water sports go: a dive boat, a dock, a creek.

name: A moment of silence for gear that outlived the season
hook: Today we say goodbye to [item]. [Real number] days. Never quit.
beats: An anchor-desk tribute to a worn item
notes: Deadpan eulogy, your own gear only, so it doesn't read as a review.

name: Man on the street: "What never leaves your pack?"
window: Anytime you're at a crag, trailhead, marina or dive shop
hook: One question. What never leaves your pack?
beats: Mic in hand, quick answers from people there
notes: Get each person's OK on camera and tag them if they want. It turns people into talent without needing members.

name: Skit: "Your clients ask what you use"
window: Anytime, for pros who teach or lead trips
beats: A friend plays the client: "Hey, what harness is that?"
Luke hands over a QR code with a straight face
"Your clients already ask. Give them one link."

name: Skit: the overpacked first-timer
window: Before a peak season (spring climbing, winter ski, summer dive)
hook: First guided day? Let's check your bag.
beats: Luke as the client pulls out absurd items (desk lamp, stapler, the mic)
"Ask your pro what they use. Their picks can live on one page."
notes: Aimed at clients, GearBook's second audience.

name: GearBook in 20 seconds
window: Anytime, again every few months in a new setting
hook: GearBook, explained by a man in a suit in a [river / snowbank / dive boat].
notes: The launch reel's script works as the base. New setting each time.

name: Live from the lift line (first chair)
window: Early Nov, around the first lift openings (check that week)
beats: In the suit and ski boots in the lift line
What's in the pocket for day one

name: Shortest day, evening news by headlamp
hook: Good evening. It's 4:30 and it's dark.
